versions.name: Geocaching
versions.description: Learn how GPS fixes a position, mark and edit waypoints, find a public cache using posted coordinates and clues, and set up a geohunt with its own course for a younger group.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
